returns.canVerify: True if claim can be verified

params._minimumStake: Minimum EMET required to submit a claim

returns.count: The number of verified (or uncontested) claims

params.claimId: The claim to mark as challenged

params.stakeContract: Address to send rejected claim stake to
params.verified: True if claim is verified, false if rejected

setChallengeContract(address).details: This creates a trustless link between Registry and Challenge contracts

setClaimFee(uint256).details: Only callable by owner. Fee goes to Treasury on each claim submission.

params._claimFee: New claim fee in EMET (18 decimals)

submitClaim(string,string,uint256).details: Caller must have approved this contract to spend at least `stake + claimFee` EMET.      The claimHash is derived on-chain from keccak256(claimText) for integrity.      A claim fee is transferred to Treasury upon submission.

params.claimText: The claim statement in plain text (stored on-chain)
params.evidenceURI: URI pointing to evidence (IPFS, Arweave, etc.)
params.stake: Amount of EMET to stake (must be >= minimumStake)

returns.claimId: The unique ID of the created claim

verifyUnchallenged(uint256).details: Anyone can call this to finalize unchallenged claims

canVerifyUnchallenged(uint256).notice: Check if a claim can be verified (unchallenged and period passed)

challengeContract().notice: Authorized challenge contract (set once, immutable pattern)

claimFee().notice: Fee required to submit a claim (goes to Treasury)

claims(uint256).notice: All claims indexed by unique ID

getClaimStake(uint256).notice: Get the stake held for a claim

getVerifiedClaimsCount(address).notice: Get number of verified claims for an address

markChallenged(uint256).notice: Mark a claim as challenged (only callable by challenge contract)

minimumStake().notice: Minimum stake required to submit a claim (immutable after deployment)
